facts.statement: Initial targeted RT-PCR and panel-based genomic tests failed to confirm the presence of the BCOR internal tandem duplication.

facts.statement: Follow-up whole-genome and RNA sequencing confirmed an in-frame duplication of 126 base pairs in exon 15 of the BCOR gene.
